prd.title: PRD: Menu Page Visual & Interaction Redesign

issues.title: Sticky co-branded header with Qraving + restaurant placeholder logo
issues.summary: Replaced the plain Qraving text header in MenuPage with a full sticky header that shows the Qraving wordmark on the left and a styled grey placeholder div on the right for the restaurant logo, with a border-b separator and z-20 so it stays above all content.
acceptance_criteria: A header strip is visible at the top of the menu page at all times
The Qraving logo/wordmark appears on the left of the header
A placeholder element (e.g. a grey rounded box labelled 'Restaurant Logo') appears on the right of the header
The header remains sticky/fixed as the user swipes vertically between sections
The header does not overlap or obscure the category label or card content
The placeholder is clearly marked in code with a comment so it is easy to swap later

issues.title: Live category name label that updates on section swipe
issues.summary: Added activeSectionName state to MenuPage (initialised from sections[0].name) and an onActiveSectionChange callback prop to SectionNavigator that fires inside goToSection whenever the section changes. The label is rendered in MenuPage between the header and the SectionNavigator.
acceptance_criteria: A category name label is visible below the sticky header and above the card carousel
The label shows the name of the currently active section on first render
The label updates to the new section name whenever the user swipes to a different section
The label is not interactive (not a button or link)
The label does not cause layout shift when the text changes between sections

issues.title: Card carousel: 70vh height, peeking adjacent cards with dimming, remove dot indicators
issues.summary: Rewrote CardSwiper to use a film-strip track approach: all cards in a flex row at 96vw each, with translateX(2vw - index*96vw) to center the active card; inactive cards render at 0.5 opacity. Container height is h-[70vh]. Dot indicators and section progress dots (in SectionNavigator) were removed.
acceptance_criteria: Each card is 70% of the viewport height
The active card has 2% of the viewport width as padding on its left and right edges
The left edge of the next card is visible to the right of the active card
The right edge of the previous card is visible to the left of the active card (when not on the first card)
Peeking cards are visually dimmed compared to the active card
The active card is clearly distinguished (full opacity, centred)
Card-position dot indicators (CardSwiper) are removed
Section-progress dot indicators (SectionNavigator) are removed
Horizontal swipe navigation between cards still works correctly

issues.title: Card face redesign: full-bleed image with bottom blur overlay containing name, description, and action buttons
issues.summary: Rewrote MenuCard's front face: image now fills 100% of the card (object-cover), bottom 40% has a frosted blur overlay using backdrop-filter+gradient-mask fading from transparent to dark, and inside the overlay sits name+price, truncated description, 'Allergies & More' (semi-transparent border), and 'Add to Cart' (red). Border radius raised to rounded-3xl. Back face unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: The dish photo fills 100% of the card width and height (object-fit cover)
The bottom 30% of the card has a gradual blur overlay that fades in from transparent at the top
Item name is readable inside the blurred overlay area
Item description (truncated) is readable inside the blurred overlay area
'Allergies & More' button sits inside the blurred overlay and triggers the 3D card flip (unchanged behaviour)
'Add to Cart' button sits inside the blurred overlay and opens the bottom sheet (unchanged behaviour)
Card corners are more rounded than the current design (e.g. rounded-3xl or equivalent)
The card flip back face remains functionally and visually unchanged
The AddToCartSheet remains functionally unchanged

issues.title: Out-of-stock card state: greyed-out overlay with disabled Add to Cart
issues.summary: Added isAvailable: boolean to the MenuItem interface and a deriveAvailability() helper in menu.ts that marks ~20% of items as unavailable (idMeal % 5 === 0). In MenuCard, unavailable items get a grayscale+brightness filter on the image, a light grey tint overlay, and both Add to Cart buttons (front and back face) are disabled and show 'Unavailable'.
acceptance_criteria: Out-of-stock items are still rendered as cards in the carousel (not hidden)
Out-of-stock cards have a visible greyed-out or desaturated overlay that communicates unavailability
The 'Add to Cart' button is disabled or hidden on out-of-stock cards
'Allergies & More' / card flip still works on out-of-stock cards (the dish details are still viewable)
In-stock cards are not affected

issues.title: "I am done" placeholder button pinned at bottom of menu screen
issues.summary: Replaced the old floating pill button with a full-width fixed button (left-4 right-4, rounded-2xl, bottom: 5vh) in MenuPage. No click handler is wired up — it is a visual placeholder only.
acceptance_criteria: An 'I am done' button is visible at the bottom of the menu screen
The button is full-width (or close to it) and clearly styled as a primary action
The button has approximately 5% viewport height as bottom margin/padding beneath it
The button does not overlap or obscure the card carousel content
Tapping the button has no effect (no handler, no navigation) — it is a visual placeholder
The button remains in place as the user swipes between sections and cards
